purpose: Descriptive support for accepted E0/E1 integration and regression. Not an executable policy, permission, approved provider budget or deployment authority.

coverage.depth: Complete method/path census and selected referenced family call chains; not every line, dynamic adapter or upstream endpoint audited.

HISTORY_READ_THROUGH.integrationRequirement: Preserve the hit/miss business result through a separately authorized and bounded technical effect. A product read grant does not grant global writes; external provider use cannot be represented as rolled back with private SQL.

DISCOVERY_METADATA.integrationRequirement: Current product/member permission precedes provider use. Verify provider budget/entitlement and source provenance without assuming every network call is a pure local read.

AI_SEARCH.integrationRequirement: Interpretation and reranking call external AI. Require explicit bounded provider use, durable intent and honest outcomes; this is not an unmetered knowledge-read grant.

BENCHMARK_SELECTION.integrationRequirement: Conditional source adoption and ordinary-role SQL/API evidence exist. Preserve server fixed organisation, current named identity and no private-to-demo fallback. It is not a live release.

PREPARED_FORECAST_READ.integrationRequirement: Default public current/verification resolvers read prepared results. Preserve preparation separation. Diagnostic or prepared-source headers are selectors, never an identity or permission.

TECHNICAL_FORECAST.integrationRequirement: Review each internal action separately. Real SERVICE identity is required; acting for a user requires current scoped delegation, revocation and idempotency. Shared content does not make private initiator, cost or job history global.

DASHBOARD_RECORDS_AND_BRIDGE.integrationRequirement: Separate approved shared series from legacy organisation-bearing DR rows. Query/filter/cache organizationId is not membership. Middleware uses configuration-dependent demo and does not consult the new provider discriminator; source adoption by SG Runtime is not dashboard adoption.

COGNITION_ADAPTER.integrationRequirement: The singleton throws unless configured; no production setter call site was found in tracked application sources. Retain that pre-existing availability boundary and private fail-closed behavior; do not invent a new runtime or claim an unconfigured business feature delivered.

SUPPLIER_LOOKUP.integrationRequirement: Map the actual named actor and private selection/provenance without assigning old demo history. Separate corporate knowledge ingestion from tenant requests and provider cost. New private role intentionally lacks unadopted lookup/global-write grants.

REPORT_PROJECTION.integrationRequirement: POST report-data is a projection, not pure read. Conditional source adoption uses the common host. Full KYS/lookup/exports/UI, real identity session and controlled release remain separate adoptions.

KYS_FETCH_CACHE.integrationRequirement: Retain field-level PII and retention restrictions. The old shared KYS table is not accepted as universal knowledge; new private initialization row-closes it. A read must not silently authorize refresh or wider person-data access.

PII_REVEAL.integrationRequirement: The token contains snapshot/list/index/expiry, not a current named-user grant. Retain org/RLS checks and require explicit current PII capability and privacy-safe audit before named-user adoption. No automatic OWNER wildcard.

EXPORT_FILE.integrationRequirement: Review each underlying restore/file branch. Check current context before source access and release, exact scoped resource, short-lived references and provider limits where applicable. Filename/token alone is not permission.

WEB_ENRICHMENT.integrationRequirement: Cached, pending and new enrichment branches differ. Preserve claim/idempotency and private subject scope; provider use needs authority. Only a field-reviewed corporate projection may become shared.

PUBLIC_POLICY.integrationRequirement: A specific public entry policy is not a product grant. Health/login and deterministic advisory are distinct from business reads and do not need fictitious tenant membership.

PREFERENCES_REUSE.integrationRequirement: Preference storage follows actual app/org/user and stale UI state must be separated. Current scanner key uses preferenceScope/nip/scope. Summary rules import financial-history.tsx (use-client); a .ts filename alone is not React-neutral runtime. Prove actual business reuse with separate host compatibility.

acceptance.newPrivateStore: 43 controlled FORCE RLS tables, apps disabled at separately dated preparation; not re-read here
